source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Starting in **[Strategic reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves)** is mandatory for this transport. Its **[ingress move](vsdata:core-rule/ingress-move)** is allowed as early as your opening [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase). On arrival, all passengers are required to exit via an **[assault disembark move](vsdata:core-rule/assault-disembark-move)**. Leave over 8" between each disembarking unit and every enemy unit.
